messages:
Nina Park: Opening a small PR to document an edge-case: when a request is truncated due to quota cap, the API returns a 429 + `X-Quota-Used` header. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/599
Arjun Rao: Good catch. Add an explicit example showing how to continue a truncated session with the same conversation_id once credits refresh.
Nina Park: Draft note: 'If you receive 429 and a partial output, save the partial text and retry after checking `X-RateLimit-Reset`. Use conversation_id to resume context.'
Felix Hart: For serverless customers, include a short snippet showing exponential backoff with jitter and token-cost estimation to avoid hitting tiers accidentally. Keep the snippet tiny.
Nina Park: Backoff snippet (JS):
```js
const backoff = (attempt)=> Math.min(1000*Math.pow(2,attempt) + Math.random()*200, 30000);
// call again after backoff(ms)
```
Arjun Rao: Also add a quick Python SDK example that reads `X-Quota-Tier` and chooses a model family accordingly (cheap fallback).
Nina Park: Python fallback sample:
```py
tier = resp.headers.get('X-Quota-Tier')
model = 'gptx-small' if tier=='starter' else 'gptx-large'
```
DocsBot: PR 599 opened by Nina Park — CI: docs-build passed ✅ Preview: https://deploy-preview-599--docs.redwood.ai
Felix Hart: QA checklist: add changelog entry under "docs: metering", validate header names with eng-runtime, and include a short troubleshooting bullet about proxies returning old header names.
Nina Park: Will update the PR with the checklist and ping eng-runtime for header confirmation. Aiming to merge Tue. :memo:
